outcome: Incidence of unintended extension of uterine incision
cohort: The study included 1,076 women undergoing elective cesarean delivery.
finding: Sharp expansion of the uterine incision during cesarean delivery was associated with a higher risk of unintended extension and increased blood loss compared to blunt expansion.
mod_finding: Sharp expansion of the uterine incision during cesarean delivery was associated with a higher risk of unintended extension and increased blood loss compared to blunt expansion.
